newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stock market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Australian stock market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Australian stock market is closed on Friday for the ANZAC Day public holiday.
On Thursday, Australian shares finished slightly firmer in quiet trade ahead of the long weekend with local investors reluctant to take positions ahead of two Wall Street sessions.
The benchmark All Ordinaries index closed up 2.4 points at 2,474.7, after touching an intra-day high of 2,480.2.
June share price index futures finished up two points at 2,479, a 4.3 point premium to the index.
